author: bardic-inspiration
name: Greencheck Tavern Basement
summary: The tavern's cellars: barrels, roots, and a nook the keeper forgot was there.
description: Cool, low, and lit by a single lantern on a hook. The walls are older than the tavern above them.

zones.name: Cellar Stairs
zones.note: Steep wooden steps down from the stairwell.

zones.name: Ale Cellar
zones.note: Racks of barrels, and a drain that gurgles when it rains.

zones.name: Smuggler's Nook
zones.note: A bricked-up alcove behind the end rack, recently unbricked.
